title: ROM Improvement Since Baseline
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rehab:rom joint_name=* rom_degrees=*
| eventstats earliest(rom_degrees) as baseline_rom by joint_name
| stats latest(rom_degrees) as current_rom, max(baseline_rom) as baseline_rom by joint_name
| eval improvement_deg=round(current_rom-baseline_rom,1)
| sort - improvement_deg
description: Compares latest range-of-motion readings against the first recorded baseline for each joint.
value: ROM delta is the clearest proof that rehab homework is paying off, not just that sessions happened.
implementation: Log `rom_degrees` and `joint_name` at intake and after each home measurement session.
visualization: Table of joints with baseline, current ROM, and degree improvement.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how much more you can move each joint compared with when rehab started.
